(pha)༄༅/ /gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/bcom la

tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes thugs// rdo rje khro bor rnam sprul pa// gshin rje gshed dpal la btud de// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde ba la ci bde bar 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar por mos pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dmar po bsams pa las 'od 'phros pas lus thams cad gang bas rang gi sdig pa sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbur brgyan par spyan drangs nas/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥs bla ma dang*/ na maḥshrī ya mā ri maṇḍa le bhyaḥs dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hās mchod yon/ oṃ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo 'dzin pa'i lha mo snying ga nas spros pas mchod nas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig /bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid stsal gang*// gang yang rjes su yi rang ba// de dag mgon gyi spyan sngar bshags// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// 'phags pa'i dge tshogs rjes yi rang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos// tshogs kyi mchog bcas skyabs su mchi// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod rnams la// rang gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi// dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yi// sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs gyur cig

/yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul// sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir// rab tu dwang bas bsten par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du// gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las pam̐ las padma a las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa zhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas srung 'khor gyi nang du padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar zhing nang dmar la gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i dbus su bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyangs pas/ gzhal yas khang pa rnams su gyur nas/ 'od slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/

phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ nag po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba'i steng du mda' yab las rin po che'i shar bu 'phyangs pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor rta babs bzhi'i steng du/ padma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa'i steng du gdugs phub cing phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres nas/ mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phur bur gyur ba'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i grwa rnams su bcud kyis gang zhing*/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa'i bum pa brgyad dang*/ dbus su rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar nyi ma dang*/ shar ma gtogs pa'i rwa dbus ma gsum dang*/ sgo bzhir padma dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ shar gyi rwa dbus ma dang*/ phyi nang gi grwa brgyad du padma dang zla ba'i gdan bsgom mo// de nas lha bskyed pa'i phyir gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsgoms pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha ྅/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la/ zhes phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po dang*/ mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bsgom zhing*/ oṃ badzra daṇḍa ātma ko3 haṃ gi byin gyis brlab pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa sbyangs/

'od zer slar 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las bdag nyid dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ spyan gsum pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sku thung zhing sbom la gzi brjid che ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma thal chen gyi rgya spangs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ cha lugs yab dang 'dra ba dang*/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur bsgom pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rnal 'byor ro// de nas yum gyi mkha' padma 'dab ma brgyad pa as mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes su chags pa'i 'od kyis/ sems can thams cad bkug zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig ler gyur pa las byung ba'i/ gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas spros pas/ snod dag pa'i gzhal yas khang rnams su bkod nas/ slar yang snyoms par zhugs pas/ rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum 'od du zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i yi ge 'bru lngar gyur cing*/ de dag kyang skar mda' bzhin du phan tshun 'dres pas/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// de nas thig le de las thig le bzhi mtshams bzhir 'phros pa las/

lha mo bzhir gyur nas glus bskul ba ni/ shar lho nas tsartsi kas/ thugs rje'i khro bo'i rje btsun yid bzhengs la// sa gsum mtha' dag rmongs pa sol mdzod cig /ces pa dang*/ lho nub nas rdo rje phag mos/ jo bo sems ni g.yengs slad bdud bzhi las// rnam par rgyal ba'i rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /ces pa dang*/ nub byang nas dbyangs can mas/ 'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid ci ste bzhugs// rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams kyis bzhengs shig /ces pa dang*/ byang shar nas dkar mos/ byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas// khyod ni stong nyid sems shing ci ste bzhugs// zhes glus bskul nas/ lha mo rnams skar mda'i tshul gyis/ dbus kyi thig le la thim pa dang*/ thig le rim pa gnyis su gyur nas/ 'og gi thig le mam̐ las ma he dmar po dregs pa dang bcas shing rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa sngon po 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i mig gsum dang ldan zhing*/ kha nas lce glog ltar 'gyu bar gyur pa'i steng gi thig le hūm̐ las rdo rje dbyug pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las/ 'od zer phar 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim pas/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ gzhan mtshan nyid thams cad gong du bstan pa ltar bsgoms nas/ snga ma ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs te bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba'i ngo bor bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsams la/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bha wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod de rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro// slar yang snyoms par zhugs shing thugs ka nas/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/

zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas babs pas/ yum gyi bha gar thig le bcu bdun du gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum dang thod pa bzhi ste bcu bdun cig car bskyed nas rim gyis spro ba dang dgod par bya'o// de'ang dbus su ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las/ gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa/ hrīḥṣṭ+rī'i sngags kyis sbyor mtshams nas phyung nas spros pas/ sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas phyi'i gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ shar du kṣe las 'khor lo kṣes mtshan pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ dzi na dzika gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas shar gyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar gyi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ lhor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ oṃ ratna dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas lho phyogs kyi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ nub tu me las padma mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ ā ro lika gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nub phyogs kyi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ pra dzñā dhṛ ka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi phrag dog sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas byang gi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ de'i phyi rol du shar du ya las tho ba yas mtshan pa las/ tho ba gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ oṃ mutka ra dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud sbyangs/

dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgor dgod/ lhor tsa las dbyug pa tsas mtshan pa las/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po phyag g.yas na dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ daṇḍa dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i bdud sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas lho sgor dgod/ nub tu ni las padma nis mtshan pa las/ padma gshin rje gshed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ padma dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs/ dran pa'i stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nub sgor dgod/ byang du ra las ral gri ras mtshan pa las/ ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ khaḍga dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi lha'i bu'i bdud sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas byang sgor dgod do// nang gi shar lhor dzā las 'khor lo dzās mtshan pa las/ tsartsi ka dkar zhing skems pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ mo ha ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi shar lhor dgod/ lho nub tu sa las rdo rje sas mtshan pa las/ phag mo sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi lho nub tu dgod/ nub byang du doḥlas padma doḥs mtshan pa las/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ rā ga ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi nub byang du dgod/ byang shar du ru las ral gri rus mtshan pa las/ gau rī ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ badzra ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi rlung gis khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi byang shar du dgod do// lha yab rnams kyi rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra ba/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang ldan zhing yum rnams kyi rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo dang 'dra ba/

rang 'od kyi thabs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi phyag g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas phan tshun 'khyud pa'o// phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod/ slar 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i grwa bzhir dgod do// shin tu rnal 'byor ro// de nas lha rnams kyi mig la sogs par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsams pa'i steng du/ mig tu kṣiṃ las sa'i snying po gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ rna bar dzrīṃ las phyag na rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang tho ba 'dzin pa/ snar kham̐ las nam mkha'i snying po phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lcer gam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ dpral bar skam̐ las sgrib pa rnam par sel ba phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ snying gar sam̐ las kun tu bzang po rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu bskyed pas skye mched byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje phyag na rdo rje lta bu/ thams cad kyang rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra zhing*/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ de gsum gyi thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi lha spyan drangs la bstim nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/

sangs rgyas rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rigs lnga yab yum gyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i char phab/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo'i rnam pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ yang dbang gi lha de dag la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sgo ba bzhi spros pas spyan drangs nas/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim par bya zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ oṃ mutka ra dzaḥ oṃ daṇḍa hūm̐/ oṃ padma baṃ/ oṃ khaḍga hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur nas/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba'i thugs kar/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge nas 'bru tsam pa bsgom mo// yig 'bru de rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar bab pas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur pa/ sbyor mtshams nas spros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gong gi mchod pa'i sngags rnams dang*// kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po// bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin// kho bos khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs// bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs// khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang*// sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo// chags pas brgyan pa khro bo'i yid// gar mdzad khyod nyid ro langs lags// sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste// rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud// gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che// hrīḥṣṭ+rī'i gsang sngags dag gis ni// khyod ni sa gsum 'khrul pa sel// rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo lags// gar mdzad khyod ni 'jig rten gzigs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/

zhes brjod do// de nas lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs// ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs// sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal// rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas// dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje gshed pos las kun byed// sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba// phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ lha mo rnams rang rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi/ lha rnams kyis gsol bas sku yongs su gang zhing tshim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /rnal 'byor chen po ste bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'od gsal ba bsgom pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das dang*/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la bsdu/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa thams cad yab la bsdu/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la bsdus te/ sems cung zad bzung ngo*// mthar nā da'ang yal bas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go

/de goms pa las mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas mnyam gzhag las ldang ba'i phyir/ 'od gsal ba las rang nyid gshin rje gshed yum dang gnyis su med par bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa snga ma ltar dmigs nas/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ de dag gi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo'i snying po dang*/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ āḥbadzra be tā lī hūm̐/ yum gyi'o// oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥratna dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā dhṛka hūm̐/ rigs bzhi'o// oṃ āḥmo ha ra tī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra tī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra tī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ra tī hūm̐/ yum bzhi'o// oṃ ā mutka ra dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdaṇḍa dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadma dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkhaḍga dhṛka hūm̐/ sgo ba rnams kyi sngags te ci nus bzlas pa bya'o// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas gtor ma gnyis mngon du byas pa/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du/ āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rakta/ nub byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/

byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du lta ba bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ des sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga shin tu bzhu nas/ rgya skyegs gyi khu ba ltar dmar zhing tsha bar gyur/ rlangs pa kha ṭwāṃ ga la phog pas de thur du lhung nas dkrugs te zhu bas 'o ma ltar dkar zhing bsil bar gyur pa las/ lag pa g.yon bstan nas/ oṃ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs/ g.yas pa bstan nas āḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs par bya/ gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas nus pa dang*/ gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan nas/ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ 'chi med rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ brjod pas dwangs shing thogs pa med par byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstim mo// de nas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pas lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dmigs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis grub pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs shing*/ oṃ rakta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ gnyis su med par bstim pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ rakta mu ku ṭā ya/ rakta dza ṭā ya/ rakta mu khā ya/ rakta shā ri rā ya/ rakta bhu dzā ya/ rakta muṇḍa ṇa mā la a bha ra ṇā ya/ rakta ra tha sa ma ru ḍhā ya/ rakta padma ā sa nā ya/ rakta a bha ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ ma ma/ bighnan/ ha ra ha ra/

tsa turmā rā na/ ni pā rā ya ni bā rā ya/ bhra ma ya bhra ma ya/ tshinda tshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tstshe da tstshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas phul la/ slar yang phyi dang nang gis mchod nas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// ces pa la sogs pas bstod la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// gtor ma gnyis pa'ang snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣṭā na ind+rā ya/ ā di na sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ steng du tshangs pa/ de'i g.yas su zla ba/ g.yon du nyi ma/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo/ de'i g.yas su lha ma yin thag zangs ris/ g.yon du khyab 'jug rnams 'khod par bsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams gshin rje gshed 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa la gtor ma 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ind+rā ya hrīḥya mā yaṣṭ+rīḥb ru ṇā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ ī sha nā ya ta/ agna ye a/ nair ṛ tyā ya na/ wā ya be na/ tsand+rā ya hūm̐/ arkā ya hūm̐/ brahma ṇā ya phaṭa/ ba sundhārya yai phaṭa/ bai ma tsi tra swā/ biṣṇa we hā/ sarba bhū te bhyaḥha/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul la/ slar yang mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas nongs par spyad pa rnams bzod par gsol nas yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badzra muḥ zhes 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad gshegs su gsol la/

gtor ma rnams dor ro// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gshin rje gshed du mos pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lces/ lus thams cad yongs su gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis kha me'i sgor phul bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o// zas kyi lhag ma/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa piṇḍa a si bhyaḥswā hās/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gti mug gshin rje gshed ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ phra ma gshin rje gshed ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ tsartsi ka byams pa tshad med pa/ rdo rje phag mo snying rje tshad med pa/ dbyangs can ma dga' ba tshad med pa/ dkar mo btang snyoms tshad med pa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed phung po'i bdud las rgyal ba dad pa'i stobs/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed nyon mongs pa'i bdud las rgyal ba brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ padma gshin rje gshed 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal ba dran pa'i stobs/ ral gri gshin rje gshed lha'i bu'i bdud las rgyal ba ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ 'dod pa'i yon tan dag pa dga' ba bzhi dang*/ phrin las bzhi dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'o// zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/

gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos thams cad dag pa'i ngo bo'o// srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo bo'o// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas nas/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor ci 'dra ba de lta bur/ snod dang bcud thams cad rnam dag dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la yid gzung ngo*// de nas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsdus nas/ gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gnas pa don byed pa po dang*/ mchod pa'i yul dang*/ phyi'i snod bcud thams cad don bya ba'i yul dang*/ mchod pa po dang*/ sgo gsum gyi kun tu spyod pa dang*/ 'dod yon la longs spyod pa thams cad sems can gyi don gyi las dang lha mchod par bsgom zhing snang ba sna tshogs par rang bzhin stong pa ngo bo zung 'jug tu shes pa la ni don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal lo// nang par ldang ba'i tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bzhis glus bskul bas/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la ldang ngo*// khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang mtshungs pa la yi ge brgya pa brjod pa dang*/ dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol ba ni khyad par ro// de ltar dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa la nan tan du byed pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyi gnas skabs rang dang gzhan gyi don byas nas/ mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// 'di yi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa/

ḍombi he ru ka dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti garbha/ gambhi ra ma ti/ niṣka laṃ ka de wa/ re bend+ra pra bha/ bla ma glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa rnams so// de ltar brgyud pa mchog las legs 'ongs pa'i// gshin rje gshed dpal sgrub thabs sbyar ba las// byung ba'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun// gshin rje gshed dpal nyid du 'gyur bar shog /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang ba 'di ni rgyal bu maṅga la zhes bya bas nye bar bskul nas/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo de bzhin gshegs pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i zla ba la rgya nag cong to'i mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
